title: Pond ecosystem question sheet with answers
subject: Science
unit: Summer 1: Ecosystems (7D); atoms, elements and molecules (7H)
source: Seeded from science/y7 lesson 53 (Pond ecosystem question sheet with answers (portal worksheet))
intro: Lesson 53: Competition and interdependence. Answer every question. Show your working. Mark it with the mark scheme and log any errors in your repair list.

questions.q: For the pond ecosystem on the sheet, answer: what would happen if (a) the pike were removed, (b) the pondweed died, (c) a new frog species arrived?
questions.a: Sensible chains of effects for each (as on the answer sheet)
questions.model: Teacher talks through (a): 'pike eat perch; remove pike, perch increase, then perch eat more water fleas'.

questions.q: Explain why bluebells flower early in spring.
questions.a: To get light before tree leaves grow and shade the woodland floor

questions.q: Why is it hard to predict exactly what happens when one species is removed?
questions.a: Organisms are linked in many ways; effects spread in a web

questions.q: If all the bees in an orchard died, what would happen to the apple crop? Why?
questions.a: It would fall: fewer flowers pollinated, so fewer fruits
questions.model: Link the steps: bees pollinate apple flowers; pollinated flowers become fruit; no bees, little pollination, so fewer apples.
